scope: macOS client to Linux workstation using persistent SSH and read-only Python helper; experiment only, no viewer integration
method: Two real TAK files; five methods, three rounds per file; rotated order; cold logical client cache per mode; server filesystem cache not flushed. No concurrent bandwidth benchmark.
timing: Cumulative stage times include client compound parsing, index discovery (including server work for server_index modes), transfer and payload reconstruction. Connection setup reported separately; viewer decode/render excluded.
received_byte_metric: Source range bytes + server-index JSON reply when present; excludes outgoing requests, OK delimiters and SSH framing.
preview: Frame IDs [0,120); independent metadata inspection confirms both samples start at0 and100Hz, so first1.2seconds. Late and sparse channels retained with appropriate zero or fewer samples.
baseline_caveat: selected_all retains previous reader full mini-stream behavior; staged readers map only needed mini ranges. Differences combine extraction strategies with staging.

validation.independent_oracle: existing independent TakContainer + full linear record scan and actual frame filter; no prefix-count shortcut
checks: All cached ranges MD5 vs full source
Every staged stream MD5 vs full source reconstruction
Every staged stream MD5 vs independent existing workstation parser and complete linear frame scan
Sparse/late/boundary/empty frame cases and raw NaN/negative-zero bytes
Overlap cache: no fetched byte requested again
Local remote-helper protocol, fragmented mapping and source-change rejection

observations: Sequential client header probes cost about100round trips and can make a small file slower than selected_all.
Remote index discovery eliminates most round trips without full source transfer.
Large sample: early preview is materially earlier; small sample: early preview saves little over full nonanalog-first, and adds completion time.
These two files and this network do not establish a universal optimal threshold.

round_trip_probe.kind: empty range request round-trip; persistent SSH; source stat checks included

exploratory_probe_trials.purpose: Exploratory client-side probe sizing, not a statistically repeated ranking
Exploratory client-side probe sizing, not a statistically repeated ranking
